name: Star Housing Finance Ltd.
summary: Star Housing Finance Ltd. functions as a dedicated financial entity, primarily focused on delivering housing-related credit solutions. The company's core operations include extending home loans, supplying capital for residential construction projects, and offering financing secured by existing real estate assets, alongside other associated financial services across the country. Its diverse range of offerings encompasses home loans for acquiring flats or houses, funding the refurbishment or expansion of current dwellings, and purchasing land for building purposes, as well as general mortgage loans. This institution was established on March 21, 2005, by Mohan Lal Nagda, Nirmal Jain, and Kalu Lal Jain, and its corporate headquarters are located in Mumbai, India.
